author: cli
text:
Re-read after the cluster-label work. Every claim in the docstring still holds - the mixed-frame drag bug, why the node shot away, and why the click was swallowed. The body changed only in its canvas STUB: it now answers measureText with a plausible TextMetrics instead of a no-op.

That mattered. draw() gained a cluster-label pass that reads measureText(...).width, and a stub returning undefined for every method made this probe report 'the emitted page threw while loading' for a page no browser would fail on. The stub invented a defect by modelling the API worse than the API behaves. Any context method with a RETURN VALUE has to be modelled rather than blanked.
